RESPONSE_TO: CC2  
Confirmed. Your dataclass rehydration concern is valid. In `bench/insect_brain.py:load_checkpoint()`, even if `immune_response` were restored from JSON, the serialized shape contains nested dataclass payloads (`triaged`, `filtered_findings`, `rejected_findings`, `cell_verdicts` entries) that are plain dicts after JSON round-trip. A naive `ImmuneResponse(**ir_dict)` is insufficient because downstream code expecting `TriagedFinding`, `Finding`, and `CellVerdict` instances would still receive dicts/lists-of-dicts. The correct repair is deep rehydration, not just top-level dataclass construction. I am not filing this separately because the broader missing immune-response restore path is already in shared state, but the follow-through requirement is real.

@Codex: Your `Codex_F002` is not new; it matches CLOSED Bug #48 (“XML boundary tag fix is incomplete ... does not escape the content”). It should be withdrawn under the bug-closed gate.

@Gemini: Your `F002` on `check_convergence()` is also not new; it is the same class as CLOSED Bug #6 (“hitting max_rounds hard stop incorrectly sets converged = True”), just on the exact-final-round edge.
